description: Get the dilution snapshot header (the heaviest dilution call): summary totals (potential new shares, their % of shares outstanding, per-family totals), the cash position (anchor cash, monthly burn, estimated current cash, runway months), the float block, and `meta` provenance. NO INSTRUMENT ROWS: call get_dilution_instruments per family, and get_dilution_coverage first. Cash is in the filer's REPORTING currency: read `cashPosition.currency` (ISO 4217; null = not determined) and `cashPosition.currencySource` ("presumed_usd" is not a measurement) before calling it dollars (runway months are currency-neutral). 🔴 FLOAT: a non-null `floatWithheldReason` means the tradeable float was NOT MEASURED; never state it as a number. A declined block (`available: false`) may carry `refusal.withheldReason`, the exact value get_float serves. `tradeableFloatCeiling` is an UPPER BOUND, NOT a float: never feed it to a market capitalisation, percent-of-float, short-interest ratio or comparison; say in words the float is at most that figure, with no ~ / ≤ / ≥ glyph. 🔴 BOUNDED TOTALS: a null total (`potentialNewShares`, `totalWarrantShares`, `totalConvertibleShares`, `totalEquityPlanShares`, `totalExchangeableShares`, `potentialDilutionPercent`) may sit beside `<key>Bound: "ceiling"`, `<key>Ceiling`, `<key>Floor`: report "at most <ceiling>" and the floor as the measured part, never the ceiling as the total. With `potentialDilutionPercentBoundReason: "stated_count_denominator"` there is NO floor: the ceiling divides by the last stated share count (as of `potentialDilutionPercentCeilingShareCountAsOf`); say "at most X%, against the count stated as of <date>". 🔴 `notMeasuredReasons[]` ({field, code, text, detail, expected {form, dueDate, status}}) says WHY a figure is null; quote it, never turn it into a value. `expectedFilings[]` lists the next periodic report(s); `status: "late"` means due by `dueDate` with none on file as of `checkedOn` (say exactly that, never speculate why); `dueDate: null` is not computed. A `kind: "annual_meeting"` row (Nasdaq 5620(a) / NYSE 302.00) "late" means no 8-K Item 5.07 vote results on file, never that a meeting was missed. 🔴 RUNWAY beside `goingConcern: true` is a contradiction the auditors flagged: report both, never the runway alone. ALWAYS RETURNS 200: read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED; it never means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check: decide from the availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted, never published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_dilution_snapshot
title: Get Dilution Snapshot Summary
